test_coverage_notes: Typical test coverage would be in RPC handler or integration test suites, e.g., tests exercising the /account_owner_info or similar endpoint. Tests should cover: missing 'account'/'ident' field (missing_field_error), malformed account (rpcACT_MALFORMED), valid account (returns owner info). Gaps may exist if there are no negative tests for malformed Base58 or missing fields, or if edge cases (e.g., both fields present, empty string) are not tested. Look for test files like 'rpc_account_owner_info_test.cpp', 'Account_test.cpp', or integration tests in the RPC suite.

string must be valid base58-encoded AccountID
